subject: reasoning
question: Suresh starts from Point A and drives 7 km towards West. He then takes a right turn, drives 3 km, turns right and drives 11 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 6 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 4 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90° turns only unless specified.)
solution:
Given: 

Suresh starts from Point A and drives 7 km towards West.

He then takes a right turn, drives 3 km, turns right and drives 11 km.

He then takes a right turn and drives 6 km.

He takes a final right turn, drives 4 km and stops at Point P

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6d8240b9547abec106f3f2a00cc9217094ad2e6c14faf600bd99a9c4dfc25ebf.png] 

So, He should drive **3 km to North** in order to reach Point A again.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
